<article class="event-detail is-active" id="ev-rri-webinar" tabindex="-1">
<p class="event-date">January 20, 2025 · 6–7 pm PST</p>
<h3>Regenerative Relations Initiative Informational Webinar</h3>
<p><strong>Location:</strong> Zoom (link sent upon registration)</p>
<p>Indigenous Knowledge Systems have sustained biodiverse ecosystems for millennia
through intentional stewardship and deep place-based ecological relationships. The
Regenerative Relations Initiative recognizes that Indigenous leadership in food
sovereignty, data sovereignty, and land stewardship offers proven pathways toward
ecological resilience and cultural revitalization.</p>
<p>This session introduced the initiative and answered questions from communities
interested in the inaugural cohort.</p>
<p><a class="btn btn-outline-primary" role="button" href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1xlIvfG9_6Mpz1KFiu3_ikssNfVE6XoWD0zvmQDLC85U/edit">Read the cohort announcement</a></p>
</article>

<article class="event-detail" id="ev-free-the-seeds" tabindex="-1">
<p class="event-date">December 8, 2022 · 10:30 am PST</p>
<h3>Free the Seeds</h3>
<p><strong>Format:</strong> Digital ceremonial release event</p>
<p>Join us for this first-of-its-kind digital ceremonial release event!</p>
<p>We released the long-awaited Freedom Bag Tag, a unique and easy-to-use label you
can put on new seed packs to legally copyleft-protect them as a public good and
ensure all future users that your seeds have freedom of use.</p>
<p>The Freedom Bag Tag was created over the course of nearly two years, including a
very lively public collaboration to create the text of this freedom-assuring Bag Tag.
This was the first step in our mission to make copyleft and open-source protections
available for the community at large and help us unite together as a community.</p>
<p><a class="btn btn-outline-primary" role="button" href="preservation.qmd">Learn about the Freedom Bag Tag</a></p>
</article>

<script>
(function () {
  var root = document.querySelector("[data-events-archive]");
  if (!root) return;

  var triggers = root.querySelectorAll(".tl-item");
  var panels = root.querySelectorAll(".event-detail");
  if (!triggers.length || !panels.length) return;

  function activate(id) {
    var found = false;
    triggers.forEach(function (t) {
      var on = t.dataset.event === id;
      if (on) found = true;
      t.classList.toggle("is-active", on);
      t.setAttribute("aria-expanded", on ? "true" : "false");
    });
    panels.forEach(function (p) {
      p.classList.toggle("is-active", p.id === id);
    });
    return found;
  }

  triggers.forEach(function (t) {
    t.addEventListener("click", function () {
      activate(t.dataset.event);
    });
  });

  // Deep link: events.html#ev-free-the-seeds opens that event.
  var hash = window.location.hash.replace("#", "");
  if (hash) activate(hash);
})();
</script>
